requirements.subtitle: Both federal and Victorian requirements must be satisfied. The 491 has stricter employment conditions than the 190.

groups.title: Federal Requirements - Department of Home Affairs

items.title: Competent English minimum
items.desc: IELTS 6.0 all bands or equivalent - Proficient (7.0) and Superior (8.0) earn additional points

items.title: Positive skills assessment - mandatory
items.desc: Required for all 491 applicants. ACS, AMI, Engineers Australia, or the relevant authority. Minimum 12 weeks validity at nomination application stage.

items.title: Minimum 65 points (including nomination)
items.desc: Base score of 50 before nomination is the theoretical minimum - in practice 70+ base is needed to be competitive

items.title: Occupation on eligible skilled list
items.desc: The federal Skilled Occupations List applies

items.title: Employment in regional Victoria - mandatory
items.desc: You must be currently employed in skilled work for an employer physically located in regional Victoria. Virtual offices and Melbourne-based employers do not qualify.

items.title: Annual earnings claim - required
items.desc: You must provide an estimate of your annual earnings in your ROI. This is a key selection factor.

items.title: Residing in regional Victoria (if onshore)
items.desc: ROIs from applicants in Melbourne or other states are generally not selected. Offshore applicants are eligible but face more competition.

items.title: Commit to 3 years in regional Victoria
items.desc: After grant, you must live and work in a designated regional area for at least 3 years to qualify for the 191 PR visa.

items.title: All ROI claims must be substantiated
items.desc: Victoria verifies evidence. Nomination applications are refused if supporting documents do not match ROI claims.
